verdicts.reason: Quote states these coding-style constraints; they are static lint/review checks, check=none is right. It bundles several items that 02 and 03 also cover.
Quote states always_comb/always_ff with p_com_/p_ff_ prefixes and documented logic sections.
Quote states the i_rst_n_ prefix rule for active-low resets.
Naming conventions stated directly in the quote.
Says only that names follow section 6. It is a cross-reference with no content of its own and nothing to verify here.
Quote states the top is a single structural top that instantiates only u_ahb2axi_ctrl.
Quote says the module is m_ahb2axi_ctrl. The rule text is mostly fine, but the instance names are only partly supported: the u_ahb2axi_axi_if name is truncated in the quote. Keep with check=none.
Quote states five FIFO instances named u_vlsit_sfifo_top_0 through _4. The 'starting at zero' part follows from the 0 to 4 naming.
Quote states both clock pins tie to i_clk_core and both reset pins tie to i_rst_n_core.
Quote states the file naming rule directly.
Describes the synthesis flow inputs. It gives no testable design behaviour and nothing for simulation to exercise.
Gives implementation freedom only (registers or approved macros). Nothing to verify. The binding part is the FIFO contract rule in AA-14.3-03.
The requirement is right but it is a synthesis-time constraint with the FIFO contract defined elsewhere. check=none is correct, so keep the strength.
Quote forbids latches, inferred tri-states and technology cells outside wrappers. This is a synthesis/lint check, so check=none fits.
